title: Takeout order received
description: Confirm that a takeout or delivery order was received with the total and pickup time. Order confirmation WhatsApp template for restaurants.
notes: List the items summary or order number so the template reads as a receipt, not an ad.

body.text: Thanks {{first_name}}! We received your order *#{{order_id}}* ({{item}} and more) for {{amount}}. It will be ready for pickup at {{time}}. Thank you, and reply here if you need anything.
